verdict.rationale: Bun's CLI/package-manager surface is extensively documented (install, pm, workspaces, lockfile, publish, etc.) and Bun even exposes an llms.txt/docs.md for AI consumption, making it scriptable and discoverable for agentic use. However there is no formal public API (OpenAPI/REST) — all openapi/swagger probes 404 — so 'API' here is really the CLI's documented commands rather than a machine-callable API contract. Missing for 10: a structured/machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or similar), independent evidence of agents actually driving Bun programmatically beyond CLI invocation.
